passage.label: he said My Lord indeed invited people night day; invitation increased not except flight; every time invited You may forgive put fingers ears covered garments persisted arrogant great arrogance; then invited publicly; then announced confided secretly; said ask forgiveness Lord indeed ever Perpetual Forgiver; send rain sky continuing showers; give increase wealth children provide gardens rivers; what matter not attribute Allah due grandeur; while created you stages; not consider how created seven heavens layers; made moon therein reflected light sun burning lamp; caused grow earth progressive growth; then return into it extract another extraction; made earth expanse; that follow therein roads passage

arabicExcerpts.text: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي دَعَوۡتُ قَوۡمِي لَيۡلٗا وَنَهَارٗا
وَإِنِّي كُلَّمَا دَعَوۡتُهُمۡ لِتَغۡفِرَ لَهُمۡ جَعَلُوٓاْ أَصَٰبِعَهُمۡ فِيٓ ءَاذَانِهِمۡ وَٱسۡتَغۡشَوۡاْ ثِيَابَهُمۡ وَأَصَرُّواْ وَٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ ٱسۡتِكۡبَارٗا
ثُمَّ إِنِّيٓ أَعۡلَنتُ لَهُمۡ وَأَسۡرَرۡتُ لَهُمۡ إِسۡرَارٗا
فَقُلۡتُ ٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارٗا
وَيُمۡدِدۡكُم بِأَمۡوَٰلٖ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجۡعَل لَّكُمۡ جَنَّـٰتٖ وَيَجۡعَل لَّكُمۡ أَنۡهَٰرٗا
مَّا لَكُمۡ لَا تَرۡجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارٗا
أَلَمۡ تَرَوۡاْ كَيۡفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٖ طِبَاقٗا
وَجَعَلَ ٱلۡقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورٗا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمۡسَ سِرَاجٗا

mainSubject.label: Noah's complaint that he invited his people night and day yet the invitation only increased their flight; each call toward forgiveness met with fingers in ears, garments drawn over themselves, persistence and great arrogance; he then invited publicly, announced openly and confided secretly, urging them to seek forgiveness from the Perpetual Forgiver who would send continuing rain, increase wealth and children and provide gardens and rivers; he questions their failure to attribute due grandeur to Allah who created them in stages, pointing to the seven layered heavens with the moon as reflected light and the sun as a burning lamp, their progressive growth from the earth followed by return into it and another extraction, and the earth made an expanse for traversing its roads

notes: Wave 10 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the undelayable appointed term (4) before Noah's night-and-day complaint opens (5); P2 ends with the earth-as-expanse and roads-of-passage argument (20) before the disobedience-and-conspiracy report begins (21); P3 runs through the five named idols, the drowning verdict, the no-inhabitant plea and the closing comprehensive supplication (21-28).
